summary: Ruhengeri Airport serves Musanze (formerly Ruhengeri) in Rwanda's Northern Province and is the closest airfield to Volcanoes National Park, the world-famous habitat of the mountain gorillas. It functions as a small regional strip handling charter and light aircraft, providing a direct aerial link for safari visitors heading to the Virunga volcanoes. The facility remains modest in scale, complementing the larger Kigali International Airport as a secondary access point for the region.
faqs:
Q: What is Ruhengeri Airport primarily used for?
A: It mainly serves tourist charter flights to and from Volcanoes National Park, one of the few places in the world where visitors can trek to see mountain gorillas.

Q: Are there regular scheduled commercial flights to RHG?
A: Scheduled service is limited; most travelers fly into Kigali and transfer by road, though private and group charters can be arranged directly to Ruhengeri.
